task_message:
Case N17: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 131x131x110 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Done. 

**Case N17 — final result:** one connected mask (3.7 mL) of the peripheral nerve sheath tumor, a well-circumscribed, strongly T2-hyperintense oval mass (~17 × 18 × 30 mm) in the posterior compartment, adjacent to but not including the neighbouring flow-void vessels (which showed dark lumina on the axial slices). The mask was seeded at the lesion centre (axial slice 47), then checked in all three planes — axial slices through the full 31–60 extent, coronal 33/38/42, sagittal 56/60/64 — plus the crop-zoomed views at the upper and lower poles. The intensity-based candidate search found no missed lesion tissue, and no stray components were present. Confidence: high.
